description: Places public addresses: each address's country, coordinates, autonomous system and operator. One provider is active at a time. The core decides which addresses need placing -- never a non-public one -- stores the answers in geo_asn and places every address again when the active provider or its build changes.

cadences.basis: Not a survey figure: MaxMind publishes no GeoLite2 release schedule on the pages read for step 4C, and a HEAD request, which is all a check costs when nothing changed, does not count against the 30 downloads a day a GeoLite account is allowed. Once a day keeps a new build well inside the 30 days the GeoLite EULA allows an old one to be used (specs/SPEC-maxmind-geolite2.md).
opnview's own: a lookup reads a local file and contacts nothing, so the figure only bounds how long a new destination stays unplaced, and it matches the discovery cadence.
